verdict.rationale: Vast.ai's first-party docs describe creating a team, inviting members, and assigning them roles. They also document scoped API keys created via `vastai create api-key`, limited to only the permissions a workload needs for CI/CD or shared tooling. That covers the core of the story: member roles plus scoped credentials. Missing for 10: details of role and permission granularity, any explicit per-member or per-key spend limits or billing controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
